_comment: Starter float/ignore rules for games + launchers, so komorebi never tries to tile Steam, Battle.net, or game windows. komorebi ships a much larger community-maintained list at https://github.com/LGUG2Z/komorebi-application-specific-configuration/blob/master/applications.json -- steps/70-dotfiles.ps1's README notes fetching it; this file is the minimal subset this setup actually needs, kept local and dependency-free rather than vendoring the whole upstream list blind.

ignore_identifiers.comment: Steam main window + games it launches go fullscreen/borderless and bypass the WM anyway
